build_transformer_model: build a Transformer encoder-decoder model instance from config and task using build_model
build_embedding_layer: build an Embedding layer with normal initialization and padding index for a dictionary
run_forward_pass: run the forward pass through the Transformer encoder-decoder model with source and target tokens
get_normalized_probs: get normalized probabilities or log probs from the model output using get_normalized_probs
add_transformer_args: add Transformer model-specific arguments to an argparse parser using add_args
